Script.name: Exchange Walker Live Loader
Script.script:
local home = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/exchange-walker-live/" local previous = rawget(_G, "ExchangeWalkerLive") if type(previous) == "table" then if type(previous.shutdown) == "function" then pcall(previous.shutdown) else for _, field in ipairs({ "transition_timer", "apply_timer", "confirmation_timer" }) do if previous[field] and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, previous[field]) end end for _, field in ipairs({ "min_confirmation_trigger", "max_confirmation_trigger", "spread_confirmation_trigger" }) do if previous[field] and type(killTrigger) == "function" then pcall(killTrigger, previous[field]) end end if previous.alias and type(killAlias) == "function" then pcall(killAlias, previous.alias) end if previous.button then if type(previous.button.hide) == "function" then pcall(previous.button.hide, previous.button) end if type(previous.button.delete) == "function" then pcall(previous.button.delete, previous.button) end end end end
_G.ExchangeWalkerLive = {} for _, filename in ipairs({ "f2ce-api.lua", "exchange-walker-live.lua" }) do local path = home .. filename local ok, error_message = pcall(dofile, path) if not ok then cecho(string.format("\n<red>[Exchange Walker]<reset> Unable to load %s: %s\n", path, tostring(error_message))) if _G.ExchangeWalkerLive then _G.ExchangeWalkerLive.enabled = false end break end end
